title: BGN regime-gamma at g0235's multipliers: stress two thirds of months AND switching 4x faster
question: Does the switching-speed lever (finding 12) compound with the stress-heavy mix that gives BGN its largest DKKM-over-FMR/FF gap?
notes:
g0235df. g0235d's economy with BOTH switch probabilities times four: p01 (calm->stress) 0.5/12 -> 2/12 and p10 (stress->calm) 0.25/12 -> 1/12. gmult is unchanged at [0.2, 3.5] and the stationary stress share is unchanged at exactly 2/3 (p01/(p01+p10)), so this is g0235d seen at g0235f's speed: stress spells 12 months instead of 48, calm spells 6 instead of 24, about 80 switches inside a 360-month window instead of 20. Those are g0235f's two spell lengths mirrored, so it sits at, not beyond, the fastest timescale finding 12 calls defensible for a price of risk.

WHY THIS ONE. Two measured facts are combined. (1) Finding 12: holding the stationary share fixed, the fair gap is monotone in switching speed, -0.0038 -> +0.0025 -> +0.0079, and g0235f is one of the file's two surviving fair gaps. (2) g0235d has the largest DKKM-minus-market of any BGN economy (+0.2190) and the largest BGN gap against the classical benchmarks: DKKM - max(FMR, FF) = +0.0488 per seed-mean, t 6.0, 10 of 10 (computed 2026-10-05 from the committed seed files), because its market carries only 26% of SR_max. Its fair gap is +0.0025 at t 1.1. The share dimension was read as flat on the fair gap, but only at the SLOW speed; the speed lever has never been tried at the stress-heavy mix.

REFERENCES (protocol v3, ten seeds). g0235d: SR_max 0.3435, EW market 0.0894, FMR 0.2467, FF 0.2506, DKKM 0.3085, fair gap +0.0025, room +0.0311. g0235f: SR_max 0.2375, FMR 0.1406, FF 0.1309, DKKM 0.1690, fair gap +0.0079, room +0.0447.

PREDICTION (2026-10-05, before any solve).
(a) DKKM - max(FMR, FF) is at least +0.03 and positive in at least 9 of 10 seeds.
(b) fair gap positive at t >= 2 and at least +0.005, i.e. speed lifts g0235d's +0.0025 as it lifted g0235's.
(c) room rises above g0235d's +0.0311, as it rose along the speed ladder at the 1/3 mix.
(d) the EW market stays below 40% of SR_max.
(e) winning DKKM penalty interior in at least 8 of 10 seeds, or a flat tail on materiality.
FALSIFIED IF the fair gap is not positive at t >= 2. Then the speed lever does NOT transfer across the mix and g0235f's gap is specific to the 1/3 share. Clause (a) failing would be the bigger surprise: it would mean fast switching lets the classical methods catch DKKM at the stress-heavy mix.

SOLVE CORRECTNESS GATE, required before any seed: J* exits on its tolerance test; the project-value Euler equation of tests/test_risk_neutral_pricing.py holds below 1e-6 AT THESE PARAMETERS (p01/p10 included); validate_bgn_gam.py shows realised and expected excess returns agreeing by regime within sampling error.
